description: Make DeepSeek Harness delegation discoverable without loading a skill or custom Codex subagent.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' "DeepSeek/DSH delegation is available through helpme_dsh. Independent subagents, including workspace-write and approved danger-full-access runs, may execute concurrently as sessions in one plugin-managed Host and shared UI at 127.0.0.1:3080. Give concurrent writers non-overlapping tasks and file ownership; never run the same session concurrently. Defaults and controls are self-described by the MCP. Treat 'DeepSeek subagent' as HelpMe DSH, not a Codex custom subagent."
